attempts.summary: Installed a root crontab entry on node1 to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15, appending stdout/stderr to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Verified functionally, then performed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured healthy baseline (boot_id, crond active, crontab, log contents), issued a native reboot whose ack returned before disconnect, polled until the node reconnected, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart, not just a service bounce), and confirmed post-restart recovery of crond (active+enabled), the crontab entry, and the log file/contents.
